---
name: Hardware or reproduction record
about: Report a new GPU or driver result, benchmark, failed experiment, or reproduction issue
title: "[Reproduction] "
---

## Environment

GPU and PCI ID, CPU, OS/kernel, driver/CUDA versions, Docker and image identity.

## Reproduction

Relevant commands, source and weight identifiers, and expected behavior.

## Observed result

Label the result VERIFIED, DOCUMENTED, UNTESTED, or FAILED. Provide the stage, actual outcome and a sanitized excerpt or evidence link. State if raw logs are unavailable.

## Measurements or workaround

For measurements, include inputs, timing definition, individual runs, median and failed attempts. For a workaround, record the smallest change and what was retested.
